title: 第一卷 第12章 丰厚聘礼，神凰精血！
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这一枚圣兵级别的乾坤戒内，自成一方小千世界！

内部空间极其浩瀚，神念投入其中，最先看到的，是堆成山的极品灵石。

如此浓郁滂沱的灵气，是沐云溪这辈子都没见过的场面！

而这仅仅只是最基础的！

她玉手轻挥，放在里面的各种珍宝，接连取出——

帝阶功法、准帝级神通、圣阶武技、各种圣阶宝丹，甚至还有一件准帝兵，三件圣兵……

更让她震撼的，是一滴金色血液！

凝而不散，散发出如烈阳般炽热的气息。

隐隐之间，有神凰虚影浮现！

精血气息逸散的瞬间，溪凝苑的大门轰然

沐乾钊不顾一切的闯了进来，双目泛红，死死的盯着那一枚精血。

“那，那是……一枚太古神凰的本源精血！”

沐乾钊心生震撼，下意识的想要伸手触碰。

却见沐云溪反应迅速，当即将一众珍宝收入乾坤戒内。

这一刻，沐乾钊反应过来，目光落在姜无痕和沐云溪身上。

“云溪，你这是……答应姜家帝子的提亲了？”

他表面和颜悦色，内心却掀起了狂涛骇浪。

那一枚造成姜家和太凰仙朝宿怨的精血，居然被当成了提亲的聘礼！

姜家这次，当真是好大的手笔！

当初创立太凰仙朝的‘太凰大帝’便是炼化了一枚太古神凰的本源精血，可这么多年下来，遗传血脉日渐稀薄。

倘若能再拥有一枚本源精血，不仅能培养出一位大帝，更能重塑太凰仙朝曾经的辉煌！

“皇兄，你似乎很久没用这样温柔的语气，跟我说过话了……”

沐云溪望着他，似笑非笑。

这时，苏灵熙和姜家众人也走进了溪凝苑。

“云溪，这些年……你受委屈了。”苏灵熙上前挽住她的胳膊，莞尔笑道，“今后嫁给姜家帝子，也算是苦尽甘来，本宫和你皇兄，都替你感到高兴……”

“你高兴的太早了！”姜无痕打断了她的话，从沐云溪手中拿回乾坤戒，“这聘礼，按理说是该给太凰仙朝。可这些年，你们这么欺负云溪，又有什么脸面收她的聘礼？”

“这些东西，全都由云溪自己支配。若有人想强抢，便是与我姜家为敌！”

音落，姜临天和姜临渊已经站在了姜无痕的身后。

这一刻，沐乾钊和苏灵熙心生悔意。

早知道姜家的聘礼如此丰厚，就算是姜无痕想娶沐风凰，也不是不能考虑！

现在倒好，闹成这样，人财两空！

“云溪，这些年……皇兄对你的确有些苛刻，但这也是没办法的事情！”沐乾钊轻叹，满脸无奈，“你当年的所做所为，不仅丢尽了皇族的颜面，更是得罪了太玄仙门！”

“你与太玄神子既有婚约在身，却又跟其他男人私奔，甚至有了身孕。若不对你加以惩戒，仙朝势必与太玄仙门结怨……”

话还没说完，就被沐云溪打断。

“说得好听！从小到大，无论做什么，你都说是为了我好。可你真正关心的，只有你自己的利益！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Within this holy-soldier-level Qiankun ring, there is a small world of its own!

The internal space is extremely vast, and when one puts his spiritual thoughts into it, the first thing he sees is a mountain of top-quality spiritual stones.

Such a rich and surging spiritual energy was something Mu Yunxi had never seen before in his life!

And this is just the basics!

She waved her jade hand lightly and took out various treasures placed inside one after another——

Emperor-level exercises, quasi-emperor-level magical powers, holy-level martial arts, various holy-level treasure pills, and even one quasi-emperor weapon, three holy weapons...

What shocked her even more was a drop of golden blood!

It condenses but never disperses, exuding a breath as hot as the blazing sun.

Faintly, a phantom of the Divine Phoenix appeared!

The moment the essence and blood aura escaped, the gate of Xiningyuan banged

Mu Qianzhao rushed in desperately, his eyes red, staring at the blood essence.

"That, that is... the original blood essence of an ancient divine phoenix!"

Mu Qianzhao was shocked and subconsciously wanted to reach out and touch it.

But Mu Yunxi reacted quickly and immediately put all the treasures into the Qiankun Ring.

At this moment, Mu Qianzhao reacted and his eyes fell on Jiang Wuhen and Mu Yunxi.

"Yunxi, are you... agreeing to the marriage proposal of the emperor of the Jiang family?"

He looked pleasant on the outside, but inside he was in a turmoil.

The blood essence that caused the feud between the Jiang family and the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty was actually used as a betrothal gift for the marriage proposal!

The Jiang family really made a big move this time!

The 'Taihuang Emperor' who first founded the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty refined the original blood essence of an ancient divine phoenix. However, over the years, the genetic bloodline has become increasingly thinner.

If you can possess another piece of original blood essence, you can not only cultivate a great emperor, but also restore the former glory of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty!

"Brother Imperial, it seems that you haven't spoken to me in such a gentle tone for a long time..."

Mu Yunxi looked at him, half smiling.

At this time, Su Lingxi and everyone in the Jiang family also walked into Xiningyuan.

"Yunxi, these years... you have been wronged." Su Lingxi stepped forward to hold her arm and smiled, "Marrying the emperor of the Jiang family from now on will be a blessing in disguise. I and your brother are both happy for you..."

"It's too early for you to be happy!" Jiang Wuhen interrupted her and took back the Qiankun Ring from Mu Yunxi's hand, "This betrothal gift should be given to the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty. But you have bullied Yunxi so much over the years, so why do you have the face to accept her betrothal gift?"

"These things are all at Yunxi's own disposal. If anyone wants to rob them, they are the enemy of my Jiang family!"

As soon as the sound fell, Jiang Lintian and Jiang Linyuan were already standing behind Jiang Wuhen.

At this moment, Mu Qianzhao and Su Lingxi felt regretful.

If I had known that the Jiang family's betrothal gift was so generous, even if Jiang Wuhen wanted to marry Mu Fenghuang, he would not have been unable to consider it!

It's better now, if things go wrong like this, people and money will be lost!

"Yunxi, over the years...the emperor has indeed been a little harsh on you, but there is nothing we can do about it!" Mu Qianzhao sighed, with helplessness on his face, "What you did back then not only disgraced the royal family, but also offended the Taixuan Immortal Sect!"

"You are engaged to the Son of God Taixuan, but you eloped with another man and even got pregnant. If you are not punished, the Immortal Dynasty will definitely have a grudge against the Taixuan Immortal Sect..."

Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Mu Yunxi.

"That's nice to say! Ever since you were little, no matter what you do, you always say it's for my own good. But the only thing you really care about is your own interests!"
